title: Swoff Configuration
description: Configuration for the Swoff offline-first service worker system

framework.description: Detected frontend framework. Used to generate framework-specific hooks and adapters. Set automatically by `swoff init`.

preventDefaultInstall.description: Prevent browser's native install prompt. When false, browser prompt shows naturally while event is captured. When true, prompt is suppressed and dev must call promptInstall() manually.

enabled.description: Enable versioned service worker (versioned SW URL, version.json, update events). When disabled, uses a fixed SW URL with hash-based cache naming.

source.description: Version source. 'from-package' reads from package.json, 'manual' uses the value field.

value.description: Manual version value. Required when source is 'manual'. Must be semver (e.g., '1.0.0').

minSupportedVersion.description: Minimum supported version for forced updates. Clients running older versions will be forced to update.

autoUpdate.description: Automatically register new service worker versions when detected. When false, dispatches sw-update-available event for manual registration via handleUpdateApproved().

autoActivate.description: Automatically activate newly registered service workers (skipWaiting). Only applies when a new version is registered — use with autoUpdate for fully silent updates, or wait for user consent then call handleUpdateApproved().

defaultStrategy.description: Default caching strategy for all requests

strategies.description: Custom cache strategies for specific URL patterns. Each value can be a strategy name string, or an object with strategy-specific options. Reactive-only fields (staleTime, refetchInterval, refetchOnReconnect, refetchOnFocus) are only valid with strategy 'reactive'.

staleTime.description: Stale time in seconds for reactive strategy. Cached data is considered fresh for this duration. After expiry, the SW serves the cached copy but triggers a background refresh. 0 = always stale. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchInterval.description: Auto-refetch interval in seconds for reactive strategy. The SW will periodically re-fetch this route in the background. 0 disables. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchOnReconnect.description: Refetch when the browser comes back online. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

refetchOnFocus.description: Refetch when the browser tab gains focus. Only valid with 'reactive' strategy.

maxCacheEntries.description: Maximum entries for this route pattern

maxCacheAge.description: Maximum age in milliseconds for this route pattern

refetchBatchSize.description: Maximum number of background refetches to run concurrently (reactive strategy). Limits burst when many cached routes go stale at once.

refetchBatchDelayMs.description: Delay in ms between batches of background refetches (reactive strategy). Use to rate-limit refetch bursts.

maxCacheEntries.description: Maximum number of cached entries (0 disables trimming)

maxCacheAge.description: Maximum age of cached entries in milliseconds (0 disables trimming)

clearRuntimeOnUpdate.description: Delete runtime cache on SW activate. Use as a security measure: when true, cached API responses are cleared on every SW update, preventing poisoned data from persisting.

navigationMode.description: How navigation requests are handled. 'spa' falls back to spaEntry on cache miss. 'default' uses the strategy as-is without special navigation handling.

navigationPreload.description: Enable Navigation Preload API in the service worker. Reduces startup latency for navigation requests by allowing the SW to fetch while the page boots.

cacheStrategy.description: Controls which requests are processed by the SW cache strategy system. 'all' processes every GET/HEAD request. 'explicit-only' only processes requests with X-SW-Cache-Strategy header (set automatically by fetchWithCache()).

spaEntry.description: Fallback URL for navigation requests when navigationMode is 'spa'

ignoreQueryParams.description: Query parameter names to ignore when matching cache keys. Useful for Analytics/UTM params that should not create separate cache entries.

normalizeCacheKey.description: Normalize cache keys by lowercasing and sorting query params. Reduces cache fragmentation.

type.description: Auth type — determines how auth headers are attached

oneOf.description: Enable GraphQL wrapper with body-hash caching

serverPush.description: Server push event configuration (SSE or WebSocket). The service worker connects to a push endpoint and invalidates cache tags when the server signals data changes.

enabled.description: Enable server push event connection for real-time cache invalidation

type.description: Transport type: 'sse' (Server-Sent Events via fetch stream) or 'websocket'

endpoint.description: Push event endpoint URL (e.g., /api/events for SSE, wss://example.com/events for WebSocket)

reconnectDelayMs.description: Delay in ms before reconnecting after connection loss

enabled.description: Enable push notification support (generates push.ts client + SW push handlers)

vapidPublicKey.description: VAPID public key for push subscription. Required when enabled. You can also pass it at runtime to subscribeToPush().
